subject: Travel plan: train option
text:
Hi,

I wanted to sort out the travel arrangement quickly so we do not leave details until the last minute. For the conference next week, the earlier suggestion of taking the shared ride on Wednesday evening is probably too tight. We would be leaving the site late, dropping people off across the city, and then facing heavy evening traffic. That could put me behind for the opening session, and it may inconvenience anyone who needs a predictable start time.

I think a better plan is to take the early train on Thursday morning instead. It leaves before rush hour, gets us to the venue with time to spare, and avoids the risk of a road delay. If we book by tonight, the seats should still be available, and the fare is reasonable when reserved in advance. We can meet at the station café around eight. Please bring your ticket code and any work materials you want to use on the trip.

If Thursday morning truly does not work for you, my second alternative would be to travel by car but leave at six instead of seven. That gives us a buffer and lets me check in before my session. In that case, I can cover the parking and fuel, and you would only need to cover the toll.

Let me know which option fits best, and send any timing constraints you have by the end of today. The sooner we choose, the easier it will be to adjust hotel arrangements and print passes.
